title: Lab Plating Series
description: Four reference-linked molecular dishes staged as polished laboratory hero images.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the cool lab bench, glass reflection logic, and controlled vapor atmosphere. Images 02-04 preserve that exact studio system while rotating the culinary experiment from spherification to smoke, foam, and cryogenic texture.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-lab-spoon-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
